page.overview:
Who is Izzy Moonbow?

Izzy Moonbow is a female unicorn pony and one of the main characters of My Little Pony: A New Generation and My Little Pony Generation 5. She is an energetic and optimistic resident of Bridlewood Forest and Sunny Starscout's first non-Earth pony friend who specializes in arts and crafts.__TOC__

Izzy Moonbow was designed by artist Lea Dabssi. During the film's concept phase, Izzy was known as simply "The Caregiver", and her design was somewhat inspired by Tree Hugger.

Hasbro filed a trademark for the name "Izzy Moonbow" with the United States Patent and Trademark Office on February 25, 2021.

Sneaksy is similar to Flanksy, both being unicorns-turned-Banksy-likes.
